en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from one of his companions, from Muhammad Bin Khalid Al Tayalisy, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who wears trousers whilst seated would not get groin pain’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from certain persons of his people from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisy from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one wears a loincloth in a sitting position, he remains safe from lower back pain.’”
